anatomical_reference.scope: Anatomy and naming limits; appearance study, not certified identification.

identification_limits: The broad supplied Lampam label is interpreted as the photographed tinfoil barb, Barbonymus schwanefeldii (also widely spelled schwanenfeldii). Minute sensory barbels are unresolved in the selected photos and are not represented; this is an appearance study, not a complete anatomical specimen.
